hints.title: Prefix Sums on Piles
hints.text: Taking c coins from a pile always takes the topmost c coins, which equals the prefix sum of length c.

hints.title: Grouping Subproblems
hints.text: This is a group knapsack problem where each pile represents a group of mutually exclusive choices.

hints.title: State Transition
hints.text: Let dp[j] be the maximum value obtained with j total coins. For each pile, update dp[j] from j down to 0.

hints.title: 1D Rolling Knapsack Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouped knapsack DP evaluated with 1D array of size k + 1.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of coin counts across piles is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: 1D DP array of size k + 1 saves substantial memory over 2D table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models problem as group knapsack with prefix sum choices.
